problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained root-finding for a differentiable, potentially nonmonotone operator F:E→E satisfying a weak Minty condition. No scalar objective or saddle-point representation is required.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact operator-value and full Jacobian evaluations, requested separately. Each query returns either (F(x),0) or (0,J(x)); both consume the same oracle budget. Answers are exact for every call index and seed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: An arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its induced norm; no dimension-dependent restriction is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: F is globally L₁-Lipschitz and its Fréchet derivative J is globally L₂-Lipschitz in operator norm. There exists xstar with F(xstar)=0, ‖x0−xstar‖≤R, and ⟨F(x),x−xstar⟩≥−(ρ/2)‖F(x)‖² for every x. Parameters satisfy L₁,L₂,ε>0, R,ρ≥0, and ρL₁<2. E,L₁,L₂,ρ,ε,x0 are public; R is hidden from algorithm construction.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/WeakMintySecondOrder.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The residual guarantee holds almost surely under the joint algorithm-seed and oracle-seed law, after a fixed oracle budget.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Return one point x with unsquared operator residual ‖F(x)‖≤ε; no averaging, last-iterate, or distance-to-solution requirement is imposed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The formulation combines nonmonotone weak-Minty root-finding across ρL₁<2 with Lipschitz Jacobians and separate exact operator/Jacobian queries. This is a specialized structured variant of root-finding; the classification does not establish novelty.

descriptionHtml:
Second-Order Weak Minty Root Finding

We seek a zero of a differentiable map F:E→E on a finite-dimensional real inner product space E. The map and its derivative are Lipschitz. A root x⋆ satisfies the weak Minty inequality ⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩≥−(ρ/2)∥F(x)∥2 for every x∈E, where ρ≥0, and a given starting point x0 lies within distance R≥0 of this root. The oracle returns either F(x) or its derivative at the queried point x. For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈E with ∥F(x¯)∥≤ε almost surely under P, the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The root-finding problem is to find x∈E such that F(x)=0. Write J(x):E→E for the Fréchet derivative of F at x. The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, and ∥⋅∥op denotes the induced operator norm. The parameters satisfy L1>0,L2>0,ρL1<2. The algorithm receives E, L1, L2, ρ, ε, and x0; the radius R may enter only the oracle-call budget.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Lipschitz map and derivative). The map F is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E, and, for all x,y∈E, ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤L1∥x−y∥,∥J(x)−J(y)∥op≤L2∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Weak Minty root and initial distance). There exists x⋆∈E such that F(x⋆)=0,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩≥−ρ2∥F(x)∥2for every x∈E.

At any point x∈E, the algorithm may request either the exact value F(x) or the exact linear operator J(x). Each request counts as one call toward a shared oracle-call budget; obtaining both at a point requires two calls. After the allotted calls, the output must satisfy ∥F(x¯)∥≤εP-a.s.

comparisonHtml:
On a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, F is differentiable, L1-Lipschitz, and has an L2-Lipschitz Jacobian, with L1,L2>0. A root x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and ⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩≥−ρ2∥F(x)∥2 for every x, where R,ρ≥0 and ρL1<2. Exact value and full-Jacobian queries are available. The target is ∥F(xout)∥≤ε, ε>0, almost surely.

Second-order weak Minty root finding: WeakMintySecondOrder.
Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations

(1): ε−1 instead of ε−2 when ε≪δ2L12/L2 and ε≲L2R2. Fixed δ, L1=L2=R=1: O(ε−1) versus O(ε−2). (1) needs Lipschitz full Jacobians and exact cubic-model roots; arithmetic uncounted. Worse δ dependence; loses at large ε. No constrained extension.
(3) (Vyas and Bullins 2023), Thm. B.1, p=q=2; restricted standard weak Minty Value and full-Jacobian calls. At ρ=0: O(1+L2R2/ε). (1): Scope extends trajectory-dependent smallness of ρ to every ρL1<2, independently of initial distance. Matches known rate at ρ=0.
(4) (Vyas and Bullins 2023), Thm. 3.5, p=2; 3/2-power defect At ρ′=0: O(1+L2R2/ε) value and full-Jacobian calls. General condition: ⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩≥−ρ′2∥F(x)∥3/2, with sufficiently small ρ′. (1) matches known rate at ρ=ρ′=0. Away from Minty, defect classes are incomparable; rates are not comparable without additional restrictions. (1) additionally requires global L1-Lipschitz continuity of F.
(5) (Vyas and Bullins 2026), Thm. B.3; bounded-operator special case Value and full-Jacobian calls; requires supx∥F(x)∥≤D and a D-dependent smallness condition on ρ. (1): Scope extends to unbounded operators throughout ρL1<2. No established rate improvement on the overlap.

Abbr: δ=1−ρL1/2∈(0,1]; ℓ=1+log⁡(1/δ); R bounds initial root distance. Each full-Jacobian query counts as one call. A=0 denotes the unconstrained specialization (its resolvent is the identity). ρ′ is the 3/2-power defect coefficient; D bounds operator norms. Minty means zero defect.

import LongTails.Template
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Defs

open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.WeakMintySecondOrder

open OracleTemplate

structure Public where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  L₁ : ℝ
  L₂ : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Public.normedE Public.linearE Public.finiteE

structure Params extends Public where
  R : ℝ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance p := p.E → p.E
  Query p := p.E ⊕ p.E
  Reply p := p.E × (p.E →L[ℝ] p.E)
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput := Params.toPublic
  valid q := 0 < q.L₁ ∧ 0 < q.L₂ ∧ 0 ≤ q.ρ ∧ q.ρ * q.L₁ < 2 ∧
    0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q F oracle :=
    ∃ J : q.E → q.E →L[ℝ] q.E,
      (∀ k seed x, oracle.answer k (0, Sum.inl x) seed = (F x, 0)) ∧
      (∀ k seed x, oracle.answer k (0, Sum.inr x) seed = (0, J x)) ∧
      (∀ x, HasFDerivAt F (J x) x) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖J x - J y‖ ≤ q.L₂ * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ q.L₁ * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∃ xstar, F xstar = 0 ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R ∧
        ∀ x, -(q.ρ / 2) * ‖F x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪F x, x - xstar⟫)
  successful q F output P :=
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _), ‖F (output ω)‖ ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.WeakMintySecondOrder
